title: 首购月份留存矩阵
context: 业务经理希望观察首购后的月度复购留存。
requirements: 线上有效订单；首次购买月为同期群，观察第0至第6月；按首购月与月偏移输出同期群规模、活跃客户与留存率；没有活跃但已观察的月份为0，未来月份不输出。
commonError: 直接COUNT订单会把同一客户的多次复购重复计数。
mysqlSql: WITH a AS (SELECT customer_id,MIN(SUBSTR(order_date,1,7)) cohort FROM v_order_net WHERE channel='online' GROUP BY customer_id), b AS (SELECT cohort,COUNT(*) n FROM a GROUP BY cohort), m AS (SELECT DISTINCT month_key FROM calendar_days), x AS (SELECT b.cohort,m.month_key,b.n,(CAST(SUBSTR(m.month_key,1,4) AS SIGNED)-CAST(SUBSTR(b.cohort,1,4) AS SIGNED))*12+CAST(SUBSTR(m.month_key,6,2) AS SIGNED)-CAST(SUBSTR(b.cohort,6,2) AS SIGNED) k FROM b CROSS JOIN m WHERE m.month_key>=b.cohort), y AS (SELECT a.cohort,SUBSTR(o.order_date,1,7) m,COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_id) active FROM a JOIN v_order_net o ON o.customer_id=a.customer_id AND o.channel='online' GROUP BY a.cohort,SUBSTR(o.order_date,1,7)) SELECT x.cohort,x.k month_offset,x.n cohort_size,COALESCE(y.active,0) active_customers,ROUND(100.0*COALESCE(y.active,0)/x.n,2) retention_pct FROM x LEFT JOIN y ON y.cohort=x.cohort AND y.m=x.month_key WHERE x.k BETWEEN 0 AND 6 ORDER BY x.cohort,x.k
